rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 20 of the 30 hours from ANCC-, ACCME- or ACPE-accredited programs, NP/CRNA certifying bodies, or board-approved sponsors; up to 10 hours of facility in-service; CPR/BLS not accepted
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed in the first year of the renewal period: competency required before the first renewal; licensed in the second year: before the second renewal.
rules.alternatives: CE is one of three methods and the nurse must document two of them: 30 contact hours of CE (or current national nursing certification), 30 hours of unpaid professional activities, or 320 hours of nursing employment in the two years before renewal. Instead, a board-approved refresher course, 6+ academic credits toward a higher nursing degree, or passing NCLEX since the last renewal also count.
rules.audit_note: Signed statement of compliance at renewal; random audit, documents due within 30 days of notice; keep records at least 4 years.
rules.notes: Board website blocks automated access; rules taken from 12 AAC 44.600-44.660 and the fee from 12 AAC 02.280. Expiration date of the biennial period not confirmed from an official page.
rules.rule_quote: (1) completion of at least 30 contact hours of continuing education for renewal of a license or current certification by a national nursing certification body, during the two years before the licensing period for which the applicant seeks renewal;
